hints.title: Substring Interval Highlighting
hints.text: Find all occurrences of each substring keyword and determine which character intervals need bold formatting.

hints.title: Boolean Mask Interval Merging
hints.text: Create a boolean array of length s where bold[i] indicates whether character s[i] is covered by a keyword match.

hints.title: Single-Pass Tag Insertion
hints.text: Mark bold[i..i+len(word)-1] = True for all keyword occurrences. Iterate across s: insert whenever bold transitions from False to True, and whenever bold transitions from True to False.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: W: count of words in dictionary
complexity.notes: Boolean array masking seamlessly merges overlapping and contiguous intervals.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Merging string slices directly requires sorting and tricky adjacent interval reconciliation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Boolean coverage mask eliminates explicit interval sorting in O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use a boolean coverage array to merge overlapping bold tags naturally.
